requirements: R1: The ticket machine starts in the Idle state with no active transaction.
R2: When the user selects a destination while in Idle, the system displays the fare and moves to SelectingTicket.
R3: When the user confirms the selected destination while in SelectingTicket, the system moves to AwaitingPayment.
R4: When the inserted payment equals the required fare while in AwaitingPayment, the system accepts the payment and moves to PrintingTicket.
R5: When ticket printing completes while in PrintingTicket, the system returns to Idle.
R6: When the user presses cancel before payment is completed while in SelectingTicket or AwaitingPayment, the system voids the transaction and returns to Idle.
R7: When the inserted payment is less than the required fare while in AwaitingPayment, the system must not print a ticket and must remain in AwaitingPayment.
R8: When payment exceeds the required fare while in AwaitingPayment, the system prints the ticket and returns change before returning to Idle.
R9: When the ticket stock is empty while in AwaitingPayment after valid payment, the system moves to OutOfService and refunds the payment.
R10: When maintenance restock and reset is performed while in OutOfService, the system returns to Idle.
R11: The system must not print a ticket unless the required fare has been fully paid in AwaitingPayment.
R12: The system must allow selection of exactly one destination per transaction.
